# Policymaker report: iteration 0050 (#311)

## What changed and why
- Task #309 is done and merged at c0e063f. The owner accepted it.
- I checked main. `policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` exits 0 with errors [], missing [] and 60 evidence references. `benchmark_ready` and `benchmark_executed` are false. The status file sha256 is eea3c32b….
- All seven milestones now have review labels. Baseline and split are `design-reviewed`, challenges is `scorer-reviewed`, and coverage, oracle, sources and tasks are `reviewed`.
- The baseline has no raw run-record contract. Gap map #282 shows this gap. It is ready work that uses only public data.
- I ordered `baseline-run-record-contract` (benchmark role, medium effort, 75 minutes, 45 turns, starts from main). It is design only: one synthetic record template and a stdlib checker. The checker must convert claims to the format that `score.py` uses and must have at least 4 rejecting mutations. It makes no runs and no preparation pin changes.
- Expected gain: a checked run-record format that a later baseline runner can fill. Check: `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/run_record.py --check` exits 0 on main, and the report lists the undecided fields.
- I updated `policy/working-memory.md` with the iteration 0050 state.

## Open items
- Owner question #308 (commit the redacted #268 readiness record) is pending. Ready work continues without it.
- Capability #169 (native jobs) is waiting. No native execution exists.
- Tool quality is not measured. The benchmark is not ready. The owner has not accepted the method. Product implementation stays gated.

## What next
- If the order is done: order one independent review from main. Then pin the files under the baseline milestone with a script.
- If the order ends partial: check the saved tag and land the work with a script (max_turns >= 25).
- Later: show the owner the effort estimate in `docs/research/0002-delivery.md`. Request method acceptance only when the remaining items depend on #169 or #268.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
